verdict.rationale: Carta documents a dedicated playground environment that mirrors production. Developers register a playground app in the Developer Portal, test without genuine credentials, and later promote the app to production, so testing never touches production data. The playground returns only static responses, which limits realistic testing. Missing for 10: stateful or customizable sandbox data (responses are static), evidence that the MCP/Claude plugins can target the playground, and independent hands-on corroboration.
